Package org.dellroad.muxable.simple

Class ProtocolReader

java.lang.Object
org.dellroad.muxable.simple.LoggingSupport
org.dellroad.muxable.simple.ProtocolReader
public class ProtocolReader extends LoggingSupport
Input state machine for the SimpleMuxableChannel framing protocol.

Instances are not thread safe.

  • Method Details

    • input

      public boolean input(ByteBuffer data) throws IOException
      Input new data from the remote side into the protocol state machine.

      Any generated events will be delivered to the configured ProtocolReader.InputHandler synchronously (in the current thread). However, this method must not be invoked re-entrantly.

      If a protocol violation is detected, ProtocolViolationException is thrown and this instance becomes unusable (any further invocations of this method will result in an IllegalStateException).

      For performance reasons, this instance assumes it may take ownership of data, i.e., retain a reference, modify, and potentially pass data back to the ProtocolReader.InputHandler at some later point.

      This method consumes all of data, unless a "close connection" frame is read; in that case, any data after the "close connection" frame will remain in data, this method will return false, and any subsequent invocations of this method will throw IllegalStateException.

      Parameters:
      data - new data received
      Returns:
      normally true, or false if a "close connection" frame is read
      Throws:
      IOException - if the ProtocolReader.InputHandler does
      ProtocolViolationException - if the input violates the framing protocol
      IllegalArgumentException - if data is null
      IllegalStateException - if this method is invoked re-entrantly by the ProtocolReader.InputHandler
      IllegalStateException - if this instance has previously encountered a protocol violation
      IllegalStateException - if the remote instance has closed the connection
